# TOSTEM Website Content Breakdown  

## Header Section  
- **Logo/Brand Name**: "TOSTEM" (large, bold text at top-left)  
- **Tagline**: "Japanese Innovation in Window Design" (gray text at top-right)  


## Navigation Menu (Top Bar)  
- "ABOUT TOSTEM" (with dropdown arrow)  
- "WHY TOSTEM" (with dropdown arrow)  
- "OUR PRODUCT" (with dropdown arrow)  
- "DRIVING EXPERIENCE" (with dropdown arrow)  
- "TADA" (with dropdown arrow)  
- "KNOWLEDGE EXPERIENCE" (with dropdown arrow)  
- "REACH US" (with dropdown arrow)  


## Main Banner (Hero Section)  
- **Background Image**: Close-up of a hand interacting with a modern window handle (silver hardware) against a light blue, water-like background.  
- **Left-Side Text**:  
  - Heading: "Perfect Fit" (large, white text)  
  - Subheading: "Tostem’s L-Fit design creates the most comfort that fit every living style." (smaller, white text)  
- **Left Sidebar Button**: "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE" (vertical black button with white text)  
- **Right Sidebar Button**: "ENQUIRE NOW" (vertical black button with white text)  


## Footer Cookie Notice  
- **Text**: "We use cookies on our website to give you the most relevant experience by remembering your preferences and repeat visits. By clicking “Accept”, you consent to the use of ALL the cookies." (small, gray text)  
- **Buttons**:  
  - "Cookie settings" (gray text, no background)  
  - "ACCEPT" (black button with white text)  


## Additional UI Elements  
- **Phone Icon**: Circular icon with a phone symbol (top-right, near "ENQUIRE NOW" button)  
- **Scroll Bar**: Vertical scroll bar on the far right of the page (indicates page length)
